links.outcome: Disease diagnosis performance when models use demographic shortcuts under domain shift
links.effect: Incorrect use of demographic shortcuts had a detrimental effect on downstream disease diagnosis performance under a domain shift; no numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: We highlight how incorrect use of these demographic shortcuts can have a detrimental effect on the performance of a clinically relevant downstream task like disease diagnosis under a domain shift.

unlisted_practices: Explainable AI framework (DREAM) to identify signals underlying AI prediction of protected attributes
Removal via balancing to quantify how much an identified signal contributes to classification performance

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates an explainable AI framework (DREAM) to uncover how medical imaging models predict protected demographic attributes (race, sex) and how demographic shortcuts affect downstream clinical tasks, focusing on safety, equity, and interpretability.
